title: ag_news output schema
description: Single-label news topic classification. Metric: accuracy.

label.description: The single news topic of the article's main subject.

labelDefinitions.World: International affairs, politics, conflict, disasters, general news.

labelDefinitions.Business: Companies, markets, finance, economy, earnings, trade, jobs.
labelDefinitions.Tech: Science and technology: gadgets, software, research, space, internet.
